The columns of the runtime's perf log (`StrataRuntime --perf-log`), in the order the file writes them, at engine `319075e3f92b` (`Strata/src/Strata/Runtime/FramePerfLog.cpp`). `<stage>…` stands for one column per stage the frame profiler registered, in milliseconds.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Frame` | The frame (FrameSample: index, work time, time since the previous frame). |
| `WorkMs` | The frame (FrameSample: index, work time, time since the previous frame). |
| `IntervalMs` | The frame (FrameSample: index, work time, time since the previous frame). |
| `<stage>…` | Each stage the profiler had registered when the log was created (the built-in ones first: Input, Assets.Update, ...; Create registers every registered scene system's stage first), in milliseconds; GPU stages (GPU.Shadows...) are the GPU's time, empty in a row without GPU times. |
| `WorkerBusyPercent` | The job system's threads. |
| `IOBusyPercent` | The job system's threads. |
| `LoadingAssets` | The asset manager after the frame (AssetManagerStats; MB are 2^20 bytes, empty without an asset manager); the last four are its texture streamer's (AssetManagerStats:\:Detail): the frame's bytes read for raised mip levels, the levels raised and dropped so far, and the textures below the level their views need. |
